title: The Protocol of Geneva
author: Ivo Zhou
blurb: Mara Yarrow, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
